paragraphs: R' Abba bar Tavlai: Bava Batra, end of chapter 4.

notes.text: The first locator is a chapter-end reference; it is not converted to an unsupplied folio. The William Davidson digital text of Pesachim 113b writes Rabbi Yitzchak ben Tavla, whereas Hyman supplies bar Tavla.

The actual Davidson Pesachim 113b paragraph explicitly names Rabbi Yitzchak ben Tavla. Hyman’s bar Tavla and the existing note remain unchanged. The separate Abba bar Tavlai chapter-end pointer was not freshly matched here, so its title remains R' and no unsupplied folio or shared father is inferred.
